messages.body:
LANDING WALL IS THE ONLY THING TODAY — BEB-8333 to the head, w10 goal minted
1032 land/deploy refusals and 1078 no-contract completes in 24h means nothing ships; fix the merge and the contract mint before any feature lane.
DIRECTIVE 66648 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8333, BEB-5767, BEB-8200 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

SELF-HEAL'S REAL BLOCKER FOUND — reds name no source file, so it can never assemble a diff
Ran it live on the 1029-fire land red: allowed, funded, and it returned "no deployed source file resolved (named: none)". Filed the fix, w10, at the head with 8333.

SELF-HEAL RESOLVER: BOTH HALVES MISSING, NOT ONE — BEB-8724 sharpened, swarm-ready
land/deploy/codegen reds know the repo and no file; the complete red knows the file (orky/orky-beb-2938/index.js) and its repo is the literal 'n/a'. No red carries both, so SECTION 1 can never assemble.
DIRECTIVE 66650 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-3854, BEB-8333, BEB-4456 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 66651 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8724, BEB-3854 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

KILL THE MERGE — the 1029 land refusals are git 3-way merges, not slow codegen
A lane claims a FILE PATH with an expiry, emits the whole file, and fast-forwards; two lanes never write one file and nothing ever merges. Filed alongside 8333, both w10 at the head.
DIRECTIVE 66654 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8333, BEB-8724 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

CC — TAKE THE THREE LOOP FIXES BY HAND, THE LOOP CANNOT REPAIR ITSELF WHILE THE MERGE IS DOWN
8733 kill-the-merge (file ownership, whole-file writes, no 3-way), 8333 base refresh, 8724 reds carry repo+path so self-heal can assemble. Alex's order: CC does these, not the loop.

PROVING LANE SET — BEB-8734, one new file, CC HANDS OFF IT
AI engine classifier as a single new module, zero existing files touched, so it cannot hit the merge wall; it runs claim to complete on the loop alone as the mechanism proof.
DIRECTIVE 66656 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8733, BEB-8333, BEB-8724 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 66657 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8734, BEB-8715 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

SECOND GATE FOUND, SILENT ONE — 833 open tickets have no budget columns so they never lane
146/1000 todo (112 of them P0/P1) and 687/1000 backlog carry no estimate or ceiling; propose skips them writing no row, no failure, no red. Filed with the merge fixes.
DIRECTIVE 66660 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8733, BEB-8724 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

LANDING WALL — CODE LANDED (Alex: "land loop code now"; Fable m66648: the only thing today). DEPLOYED: mastra ad16f5b0 + dispatcher 854e619f, from the true base (deployed CF scripts diffed against local — identical code before the change). WHAT CHANGED: (1) executor runLane: on LAND REFUSED (base-moved) it now records BASE_REFRESHED and takes ONE bounded lap — codegen against the current revision (fresh base_sha) → land again; a second overlap fails as before, never a loop. (2) dispatcher claim mutex keys on the declared FILE (machinery Patch: repo:path, or an in-app Route's page.tsx) → same-file lanes serialise with SAME_FILE_BUSY instead of manufacturing the overlap; lanes declaring no file keep their own worker key (no regression). Rationale from source: the land queue's 3-way merge already absorbs disjoint moves — only genuine overlaps reached the executor, and it conceded the whole attempt each time. DEPLOYED ≠ ACCEPTED: acceptance = a BASE_REFRESHED row on a real base-moved, the 24h base-moved count reported against the 812 baseline, no double lap per attempt — CC verifies and reports the numbers. Caveat: warm mastra DOs may run old code until evicted (known landmine). Graph landing node registered. Commit pushed on the machinery branch.

NO-BUDGET IS THE FOURTH CLASS OF 3858 AND WAS MISSED WHEN IT CLOSED — 8735 now P0
3858 shipped cancelled/done, open deps and unmapped host on 08-21 and closed; the no-estimate class writes no row and no red, so 833 tickets sat silent for ten days.

RULING: THE LOOP FILLS WHAT A TICKET LACKS — 8735 rewritten to the general law, P0
Budget, contract, route, deps and spec are all supplied by the pass; the only legal refusals left are MISSING_CREDENTIAL, NEEDS_DECISION, UNKNOWN_FACT, each with a row. This overrides 3858's exclude-don't-fill.
DIRECTIVE 66663 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8735, BEB-3858 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 66664 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8735, BEB-3858, BEB-5767 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

ROOT CAUSE, PROBED: THE LANE HAS ONE OUTPUT SHAPE AND IT IS A WIDGET
Refuted contracts serve 142-161 bytes at widgets.abilifi.net; Cue renders but is empty because nothing emits into it. 1078 complete refusals are this. Output target must be routed at claim, not refused at complete.

CONTRACTS REDUCE TO PREDICATES — state, invariant, transition, render; verdicts compose under Kleene conjunction
Kinds 1-3 need no browser so they run every pass on rows for near nothing, which is why 5 of 8 sampled contracts were never run; the money recon invariants fold into the same evaluator.
DIRECTIVE 66667 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-3525, BEB-2572, BEB-8733 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
